howto.name: Upload the PDF
howto.text: Select a PDF up to 500 MB containing the text you want to highlight.

howto.name: Enter your search phrase
howto.text: Type the word or phrase to highlight. Matching ignores capitalisation, so invoice also finds Invoice and INVOICE; the Case sensitive switch does not change this at present.

howto.name: Pick a highlight color
howto.text: Choose yellow, green, pink, blue, or orange. Highlights are added as real PDF annotations.

howto.name: Download the highlighted PDF
howto.text: Click Highlight. The tool finds every occurrence on every page and writes a new PDF with a highlight annotation over each match.

faq.q: Are the highlights real PDF annotations or flattened images?
faq.a: Real PDF annotations. They render in every PDF viewer and can be removed later if you reopen the file in an editor. Nothing about the underlying text is changed.

faq.q: Can I highlight multiple phrases at once?
faq.a: Run the tool once per phrase. Each run preserves previous highlights, so you can layer different colors for different keywords.
No. Matches are found regardless of case, and the Case sensitive switch currently makes no difference, so check the result when capitalisation matters.
